entities.summary: Omar Harfouch is a French-Lebanese composer and businessman. Owner of a communications group in Ukraine, he is known in France for his participation in the reality show I'm a Celebrity, Get Me Out of here! and for his many appearances at jet set parties, in videos, and in celebrity magazines. He is a regular donor and guest at AMFAR charity dinner in Cannes. Co-owner of the international TV channel HDFashion & LifeStyle. Owner of the French magazine Entrevue.
